title: Union Pacific Pays it Forward with 'What Did You Build?' Social Media Campaign
summary: Beginning March 2, Union Pacific invites everyone to show off something they’ve built. The best submissions will appear on Union Pacific’s Instagram page, and the Union Pacific Foundation will donate $100 to the participant’s choice of four charities.
